name: key-value

frames.best_why: Three filled pairs plus a fresh empty row and the Add button are all visible without a cursor in the way.

tagline: Rows of key and value fields with remove crosses and an add button.
summary: An editor for key/value pairs where each row has a monospaced key field, a value field and a remove button, plus an add button that appends an empty row. Pasting a .env listing fills several rows at once.
appearance: A dark form under a small heading and a grey hint line. Each row pairs a narrow outlined key box with a wider outlined value box, both with grey borders, followed by a square cross button; a full-width outlined Add button sits under the rows.
behaviour: Typing in a key or value updates the pair immediately and checks for duplicate keys, showing a red message under the field. Add appends a new empty row and focuses it, the cross deletes a row, and pasting several KEY=value lines expands them into separate rows.
demo_content: Environment variables DATABASE_URL, AWS_REGION and SENTRY_DSN holding a postgres URL, eu-west-1 and a DSN.
search_phrases: edit environment variables in a list
editor for pairs of names and values
add and remove rows of fields
paste a dotenv file into a form
headers editor with key and value
two column text inputs with remove
use_when: A settings or deploy form must edit a variable number of key/value pairs.
avoid_when: Every row pairs a text field with a growing textarea, so long values make rows tall in a narrow panel.
customise: Pass a default or controlled array of pairs and a change handler; placeholders, row limits, duplicate rules, paste, trimming, disabled state and validation callbacks are props.
weight_why: Plain inputs with local state and no animation, canvas or polling.

a11y.note: Fields rely on placeholders rather than labels, though the list uses roles and errors are linked with aria-describedby and role alert.

issues: Fields have placeholders but no visible labels, so their meaning disappears once filled.
polish_why: Tidy and functional with clear validation; placeholder-only labels keep it ordinary.
title: Key Value
